title: 荷兰东印度公司成立
titleEn: Founding of the Dutch East India Company
what: 世界上第一家公开发行股票、可自由转让股份的跨国股份公司成立。
whatEn: The first multinational joint-stock company to issue publicly tradable shares was founded.
why: 远洋贸易风险巨大、需要长期巨额资本，合伙制无法承担，于是出现了有限责任与股份转让机制。
whyEn: Long-distance trade was risky and capital-hungry beyond partnership capacity, so limited liability and share transfer emerged.
impact: 催生了阿姆斯特丹证券交易所与近代资本市场，也为公司治理、审计与信息披露制度埋下伏笔。
impactEn: It spawned the Amsterdam stock exchange and modern capital markets, planting the seeds of corporate governance, audit and disclosure.

sources.label: 荷兰东印度公司历史档案研究
sources.labelEn: Historical research on the Dutch East India Company

title: 《国富论》出版
titleEn: The Wealth of Nations Is Published
what: 亚当·斯密系统论述分工、市场机制与自由贸易，经济学第一次成为独立学科。
whatEn: Adam Smith set out division of labour, market mechanisms and free trade, founding economics as a discipline.
why: 工业革命前夕，重商主义管制盛行，需要一套解释财富来源的新框架。
whyEn: On the eve of industrialisation, mercantilist controls prevailed and a new framework for the sources of wealth was needed.
impact: 确立了「市场协调分散决策」的核心命题，直接影响此后两百多年的经济政策与贸易秩序。
impactEn: Established the core proposition that markets coordinate dispersed decisions, shaping economic policy and trade for two centuries.

title: 第一次现代经济危机
what: 投机性投资与信贷扩张后急剧收缩，多家银行倒闭，失业与破产同时上升。
whatEn: Speculative investment and credit expansion collapsed abruptly, banks failed and unemployment and bankruptcies rose together.
why: 新兴的银行体系与股票市场第一次把信贷、投资与情绪连成放大回路。
whyEn: For the first time the new banking system and stock market linked credit, investment and sentiment into an amplifying loop.
impact: 证明危机是工业化金融体系的常态特征，推动了公司法、银行监管与最后贷款人角色的讨论。
impactEn: Proved crises are a regular feature of industrial financial systems, prompting debate on company law, bank regulation and a lender of last resort.

sources.label: 英国 1825 年金融危机史料汇编
sources.labelEn: Compiled sources on the British crisis of 1825

title: 古典金本位形成
titleEn: The Classical Gold Standard Takes Shape
what: 主要经济体把本币与黄金固定挂钩，形成事实上的固定汇率体系。
whatEn: Major economies pegged their currencies to gold, creating a de facto fixed-rate system.
why: 贸易与投资扩张需要稳定的汇兑环境，而黄金被视为超越国家信用的锚。
whyEn: Expanding trade and investment needed exchange-rate stability, and gold was seen as an anchor beyond state credit.
impact: 促进了国际贸易与资本流动，但也限制了逆周期调控空间，最终在大萧条与战争冲击下瓦解。
impactEn: It boosted trade and capital flows while restricting countercyclical policy, and it fell apart under depression and war.

title: 大萧条
what: 股市崩盘后信贷收缩、银行连锁倒闭，全球产出与物价深度下滑，失业率飙升。
whatEn: After the crash, credit contracted and banks failed in chains; global output and prices fell deeply and unemployment soared.
why: 货币紧缩、金本位约束、银行挤兑与贸易保护主义相互强化，政策失误放大了冲击。
whyEn: Monetary tightening, the gold standard, bank runs and protectionism reinforced each other, and policy errors amplified the shock.
impact: 催生了凯恩斯革命、存款保险、证券监管与布雷顿森林体系，重塑了此后八十年的宏观政策框架。
impactEn: It produced the Keynesian revolution, deposit insurance, securities regulation and Bretton Woods, reshaping macro policy for eighty years.

sources.label: 弗里德曼、施瓦茨《美国货币史》
sources.labelEn: Friedman & Schwartz, A Monetary History of the United States

title: 《就业、利息和货币通论》出版
what: 凯恩斯提出总需求不足会导致持续失业，宏观经济学由此诞生。
whatEn: Keynes argued insufficient aggregate demand causes persistent unemployment, and macroeconomics was born.
why: 古典理论无法解释大萧条后的长期高失业，需要一套以总量需求为核心的新框架。
whyEn: Classical theory could not explain persistent mass unemployment, so a framework centred on aggregate demand was needed.
impact: 战后三十年财政与货币政策成为调控常态，并演化为今天的新凯恩斯主义模型。
impactEn: For three decades fiscal and monetary policy became routine tools, evolving into today's New Keynesian models.

sources.label: 凯恩斯《就业、利息和货币通论》

title: 布雷顿森林体系确立
titleEn: The Bretton Woods System Is Established
what: 美元与黄金挂钩、其他货币与美元挂钩的固定汇率体系建立，并成立 IMF 与世界银行。
whatEn: A fixed-rate system pegged the dollar to gold and other currencies to the dollar, with the IMF and World Bank created.
why: 战后重建需要稳定汇率与融资渠道，同时要避免重蹈 1930 年代竞争性贬值的覆辙。
whyEn: Reconstruction needed stable rates and financing while avoiding a repeat of 1930s competitive devaluation.
impact: 带来近三十年的贸易扩张与相对稳定，同时确立了以 IMF 为核心的国际货币协调机制。
impactEn: It delivered nearly three decades of trade expansion and relative stability and established IMF-centred monetary coordination.

sources.label: IMF 布雷顿森林体系历史档案
sources.labelEn: IMF historical archives on Bretton Woods

title: 尼克松冲击：美元与黄金脱钩
titleEn: The Nixon Shock: the Dollar Leaves Gold
what: 美国单方面停止美元兑换黄金，布雷顿森林体系固定汇率基础崩塌。
whatEn: The United States suspended dollar convertibility into gold, destroying the fixed-rate basis of Bretton Woods.
why: 长期财政赤字与海外美元债务使黄金储备不足以支撑承诺兑换。
whyEn: Persistent deficits and overseas dollar liabilities left gold reserves unable to honour convertibility.
impact: 世界进入信用货币与浮动汇率时代，货币政策获得更大空间，也带来更高的通胀风险。
impactEn: The world entered the fiat-money and floating-rate era: more monetary room and higher inflation risk.

sources.label: 美联储历史档案 1971 年公告

title: 第一次石油危机
what: 石油禁运与价格暴涨数倍，工业国同时出现高通胀与经济停滞。
whatEn: An oil embargo and a multi-fold price rise hit industrial economies with inflation and stagnation at once.
why: 地缘冲突触发供给中断，而需求短期缺乏弹性，涨价压力迅速传导到全产业链。
whyEn: Geopolitical conflict cut supply while demand was inelastic in the short run, transmitting price pressure across supply chains.
impact: 「滞胀」成为现实，凯恩斯式需求管理失效，理论与政策转向货币主义与供给侧。
impactEn: 'Stagflation' became real, Keynesian demand management failed and thinking turned to monetarism and supply-side policy.

sources.label: IEA 石油危机回顾报告
sources.labelEn: IEA retrospective on the oil crises

title: 沃尔克紧缩
what: 美联储把政策利率提高到 20% 上下的历史高位，以两年深度衰退换取通胀回落。
whatEn: The Federal Reserve raised policy rates towards 20%, accepting a deep two-year recession to break inflation.
why: 通胀预期已经根深蒂固，只有足够强烈的紧缩才能重建央行可信度。
whyEn: Inflation expectations had become entrenched, so only decisively severe tightening could rebuild credibility.
impact: 通胀预期被锚定，奠定了此后四十年央行独立性与通胀目标制的制度共识。
impactEn: Expectations were anchored, establishing a forty-year consensus on central bank independence and inflation targeting.

sources.label: 美联储联邦基金利率历史数据
sources.labelEn: Federal Reserve historical federal funds rate data

title: 广场协议
what: 五国联合干预外汇市场，推动美元对日元与马克大幅贬值。
whatEn: Five countries jointly intervened in currency markets, driving a sharp depreciation of the dollar against the yen and mark.
why: 美国贸易逆差与保护主义压力上升，希望通过汇率调整而非关税解决失衡。
whyEn: With a widening US trade deficit and rising protectionism, exchange-rate adjustment was preferred to tariffs.
impact: 日元快速升值长期影响日本产业与资产价格，成为讨论汇率协调与资产泡沫的经典案例。
impactEn: The yen's rapid appreciation shaped Japanese industry and asset prices, making it a classic case in exchange-rate coordination and bubbles.

sources.label: 广场协议联合声明全文

title: 亚洲金融危机
what: 货币与资产价格暴跌，短期外债无法续借，多国被迫求助国际救助并陷入深度衰退。
whatEn: Currencies and asset prices collapsed, short-term foreign debt could not be rolled over and countries sought international rescue.
why: 固定汇率、大量短期外币借款与本币资产之间的期限和货币错配，一旦资本外流便迅速崩溃。
whyEn: Pegged rates, large short-term foreign borrowing and local-currency assets created currency and maturity mismatch that unravelled on outflows.
impact: 亚洲多国转向浮动汇率与外汇储备积累，IMF 的救助条件也引发广泛争论与改革。
impactEn: Many Asian economies moved to floating rates and reserve accumulation, and IMF conditionality came under intense debate and reform.

sources.label: IMF 亚洲金融危机专题评估
sources.labelEn: IMF assessments of the Asian financial crisis

title: 全球金融危机
what: 次贷违约引发抵押证券暴跌，大型金融机构倒闭或被救助，全球信贷市场冻结。
whatEn: Subprime defaults crashed mortgage securities, major institutions failed or were rescued, and global credit markets froze.
why: 高杠杆、复杂证券化、期限错配与监管盲区叠加，把局部房贷风险放大为系统风险。
whyEn: High leverage, complex securitisation, maturity mismatch and regulatory blind spots amplified local mortgage risk into systemic risk.
impact: 催生宏观审慎监管、压力测试与《巴塞尔协议 III》，并开启长达十余年的低利率与量化宽松时代。
impactEn: It produced macroprudential regulation, stress testing and Basel III, and opened a decade-long era of low rates and quantitative easing.

sources.label: 美国金融危机调查委员会最终报告
sources.labelEn: US Financial Crisis Inquiry Commission final report

title: 疫情冲击与空前宽松
titleEn: The Pandemic Shock and Unprecedented Easing
what: 供给与需求同时停摆，各国推出史无前例的财政转移与资产购买计划。
whatEn: Supply and demand halted together, and governments launched unprecedented fiscal transfers and asset purchases.
why: 封控直接切断供给，收入骤降又冲击需求，需要「直达居民」的财政手段以避免资产负债表崩塌。
whyEn: Lockdowns cut supply while income collapse hit demand, requiring direct-to-household fiscal support to prevent balance-sheet collapse.
impact: 避免了债务通缩式萧条，但也带来后续通胀压力、财政债务上升与央行资产负债表大幅扩张。
impactEn: It avoided a debt-deflationary slump but left higher inflation, larger public debt and greatly expanded central bank balance sheets.

sources.label: IMF 财政监测 2021 年疫情应对评估
sources.labelEn: IMF Fiscal Monitor, pandemic response assessment

title: 全球通胀与快速加息
titleEn: The Global Inflation Surge and Rapid Hiking
what: 多国通胀升至数十年高位，主要央行以历史级速度加息，资产估值与房地产明显承压。
whatEn: Inflation hit multi-decade highs in many countries and major central banks hiked at historic speed, pressuring valuations and housing.
why: 供给冲击、需求结构变化与劳动力紧张叠加，使通胀从局部品类扩散为核心通胀。
whyEn: Supply shocks, shifted demand composition and tight labour markets spread inflation from individual categories into core measures.
impact: 再度验证央行可信度与通胀预期管理的重要性，也让「滞胀风险」重新回到政策讨论中心。
impactEn: It re-confirmed the importance of credibility and expectation management and returned stagflation risk to policy debate.

sources.label: BIS 年度经济报告 通胀与加息章节
sources.labelEn: BIS Annual Economic Report, inflation and policy chapter

title: 中国改革开放启动
titleEn: China Launches Reform and Opening Up
what: 以家庭联产承包、设立经济特区与逐步放开价格、外贸与外资管制为起点，中国从高度集中的计划经济体向市场化转型。
whatEn: Beginning with household responsibility, special economic zones and gradually relaxing controls on prices, trade and foreign investment, China shifted from a centrally planned economy toward the market.
why: 计划经济下的短缺与效率瓶颈难以为继，需要引入市场激励与对外开放来释放生产力。
whyEn: Shortages and inefficiency under planning became unsustainable, so market incentives and opening up were needed to unleash productivity.
impact: 此后四十余年实现了高速工业化与大规模减贫，同时也伴随收入与区域差距、环境与债务等难题，是从计划到市场的标志性转折。
impactEn: It delivered rapid industrialisation and mass poverty reduction over the next four decades, alongside challenges of inequality, the environment and debt — a landmark turn from plan to market.

sources.label: 世界银行 中国改革开放四十年回顾
sources.labelEn: World Bank, China 40 Years of Reform and Development

title: 中国加入世界贸易组织
titleEn: China Joins the World Trade Organization
what: 中国结束十五年复关与入世谈判，正式成为 WTO 成员，承诺大幅降低关税并削减非关税壁垒。
whatEn: After fifteen years of negotiations, China acceded to the WTO, committing to steep tariff cuts and reduced non-tariff barriers.
why: 融入多边贸易体系被视为以外部规则倒逼国内改革、并换取稳定出口市场的途径。
whyEn: Joining the multilateral system was seen as using external rules to push domestic reform while securing stable export markets.
impact: 出口与制造业产能快速扩张，中国深度嵌入全球产业链；同时也带来了产业冲击、贸易摩擦与对外依赖的讨论。
impactEn: Exports and manufacturing capacity expanded rapidly and China became deeply embedded in global supply chains; it also sparked debate on industry shocks, trade friction and external dependence.

sources.label: WTO 中国加入议定书
sources.labelEn: WTO Protocol on the Accession of China
